remarks: This spacious and well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home offers a comfortable and inviting living space. The large eat-in kitchen is perfect for meals and gatherings, while the expansive living room provides plenty of room for relaxation and entertainment. The home includes the convenience of a half bath with laundry on the main level. Upstairs you will find three bedrooms and full bath. An extra space in the basement can be utilized as an office, storage area, or recreational room, providing even more versatility. Additionally, there is an outdoor patio and shared yard along with off street parking for one car. Don't miss out on this fantastic rental opportunity! Schedule a tour today and see all that this lovely home has to offer. Requirements, no pets, 650+ credit score, references, 2 x monthly income, background/credit check.
